scope: Regenerative braking in chronological endurance simulations only

source.description: User-provided joined endurance accumulator telemetry for car 1001

source_schema.malformation: The CSV header contains six names while every data row contains eight values.
source_schema.repair_basis: The final counters satisfy net_energy_kwh = outgoing_energy_kwh - incoming_energy_kwh.

sign_convention.terminal_power: Positive power is accumulator discharge; negative power is energy entering the accumulator.
sign_convention.regen_magnitude: Reported regenerative-power magnitudes are the positive magnitude of negative source power.

chosen_target.time_weighting: left-sample zero-order hold over each timestamp interval
chosen_target.rms_denominator: Only time intervals satisfying power_kw < -1.0 kW

modeling_interpretation.use: Calibrate or constrain the time-weighted conditional RMS of simulated negative accumulator-terminal power during active regenerative intervals.
modeling_interpretation.cap_policy: The modeled conditional active RMS should not exceed 8.574267142409962 kW when this measured behavior is used as a cap.
modeling_interpretation.not_an_instantaneous_limit: The RMS target must not be applied as a per-sample power clamp. Instantaneous motor, inverter, accumulator charge-current, terminal-voltage, SOC, and charge-power constraints remain separate.
modeling_interpretation.whole_event_reporting: Also report whole-event-equivalent RMS, active duration, duty cycle, peak power, and integrated recovered energy so RMS cannot obscure the braking duty cycle.
modeling_interpretation.comparison_policy: For an unbiased pack comparison, calibrate a braking command scale on the baseline vehicle and hold that command policy fixed across candidate packs; report achieved RMS after each pack's physical charge-acceptance constraints.
modeling_interpretation.regen_off_behavior: A disabled or zero-target regeneration policy must preserve the existing mechanical-braking-only endurance result.
